answer: Budget-pooled cluster isolation: every identity keeps a crystal-clear public ledger of who attested it and when, each entry signed with its own quill. A periodic pass correlates these ledgers - clones that lean on the same partner set at the same times merge into one cluster - and every cluster shares one payout budget, like an island with a single freshwater lens no matter how many wells you drill. Extra wells cost full price but draw from that fixed lens, so sybil scale subtracts value instead of adding it.
